notes: The Noe Valley Voice, Noe Valley's community monthly, every item in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers catalogued under that title: 337 items, May 1977 to February 2011, of which two are duplicate scans of one issue (November 1989: noevalleyvoice09unse and noevalleyvoice139unse; December 1989/January 1990: noevalleyvoice1310unse and noevalleyvoice10unse), so 335 issues. Ten 2004 items are catalogued 2004-01-01; their months are read from the issues' own page footers (see the dossier). Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index; printed pages from _page_numbers.json where the item has one. extra.candidate is the reader candidate number in the run's scratch merge.
